about: Lays controls along one direction, a semantic gap apart or attached into one control with several parts.

alignment.about: Where controls of different heights sit across the flow.
alignment.title: Alignment

distribution.about: How the room left over along the flow is shared, in a group stretched to the width of a column.
distribution.title: Distribution

gaps.about: Every gap a group offers, which an attached group ignores.
gaps.title: Gaps

grow.about: Children that share the room evenly rather than taking what each needs.
grow.title: Grow

orientation.about: Both directions, apart and attached. The corners between attached neighbours are squared and the border between them is drawn once, so three buttons read as one control with three parts.
orientation.title: Orientation
